-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Check that the desktop and browser are up.

get-state.name: get-state
get-state.description: Look at your computer: who is in control, the focused window, the browser tab and an accessibility snapshot of the page with element refs ([ref=e12]) to use with click/type-text/scroll. Start every task with this. Set screenshot=true when you need pixels (dialogs, canvas, images, layout).

screenshot.name: screenshot
screenshot.description: Screenshot of the whole screen (JPEG, downscaled). Coordinates you then pass to click/scroll/drag are pixels of THIS image; scaling to the real screen is automatic. Prefer get-state (text) when the target is in the web page.

click.name: click
click.description: Click an element by ref (from the latest snapshot) or at x,y (pixels of the latest screenshot). Returns the fresh state. Ref clicks are delivered to the element; coordinate clicks are synthetic input — check the returned state.

params.ref: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over coordinates for anything in the web page.
params.x: X in pixels of the LATEST SCREENSHOT (scaled to screen automatically). Use when there is no ref.
params.y: Y in pixels of the latest screenshot.
params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

type-text.name: type-text
type-text.description: Type text. With ref: fills that field (replacing its content unless clear=false) and reads it back (verified). Without ref: types into whatever has keyboard focus (unverified). Never type passwords or other secrets: ask the user to take over and type them.

params.ref: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over coordinates for anything in the web page.
params.clear: With ref: replace existing content (default true).
params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

press-key.name: press-key
press-key.description: Press keys on the focused window: one key or chord, or several separated by spaces. Examples: "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "ctrl+l", "ctrl+shift+t", "ctrl+a Delete", "PageDown".

params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

scroll.name: scroll
scroll.description: Scroll the page or the element under a ref / point. amount is in wheel notches (~100 px each, default 5).

params.ref: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over coordinates for anything in the web page.
params.x: X in pixels of the LATEST SCREENSHOT (scaled to screen automatically). Use when there is no ref.
params.y: Y in pixels of the latest screenshot.
params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

drag.name: drag
drag.description: Drag with the left button from one point to another (pixels of the latest screenshot).

params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

open-url.name: open-url
open-url.description: Open a URL in the desktop browser (starts it if closed), in the current tab or a new one. Waits for the page to load and returns its snapshot.

params.newTab: Open in a new tab (default false).
params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tabs.name: tabs
tabs.description: List, switch to, close or open browser tabs. Tab indexes come from action=list.

wait.name: wait
wait.description: Wait for some text to appear in the page (preferred) or for a fixed time, then return the state.

params.text: Wait until this text is visible in the page.
params.observe: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

run-command.name: run-command
run-command.description: Run a shell command on your computer as its user (bash, in the home directory) and get stdout/stderr. For files (e.g. ~/Downloads), quick checks and scripts. Not root: no system package installs.

control-status.name: control-status
control-status.description: Who is driving this computer right now: you (agent) or a person who took over from the live view. While a person is in control your input tools fail with human_has_control.

name: Computer
description: Gives an agent its own persistent Linux desktop with a real browser. The agent sees and drives it (screen, accessibility tree, mouse, keyboard); you can watch live and take over to log into any website, and the session stays logged in across restarts.
tagline: Your agent's own Linux computer with a browser you can log into

changelog.notes: Initial release — a persistent desktop and browser per agent, live view with take-over, and computer-use tools
